about_the_game: Ever wanted to know what it's like to be short. Well wonder no more, now's your chance to step into their tiny little shoes just to see how hard life can be for someone so short. Just getting out of bed can be a hassle because it's a long fall for them. You'll have to carefully maneuver around your apartment, and that's just the start. When you're this small Everything is out of reach. You will need to pick things up and drag them around your apartment to create platforms for you to reach high up places, but be careful because even small heights are enough to break someone this tall.  When dragging items isn't working just push things over and roll them around for even more creative path making. All of this just to reach your sweet sweet coffee. Collect them all as fast as you can but be careful of the fall. Best of luck, and when you get angry just remember people have to go through this every day.
